tools.name: list_pages
tools.description: List page URLs on https://sitemcp.dev/ (from its sitemap, or links on the homepage).

tools.name: read_page
tools.description: Fetch a page from https://sitemcp.dev/ and return its main content as Markdown. Long pages are paginated with offset.

tools.name: search_site
tools.description: Search https://sitemcp.dev/ for pages relevant to a query. Returns matching pages with snippets.

tools.name: get_site_info
tools.description: Orientation for https://sitemcp.dev/: title, description, language, sitemaps, robots.txt, pages discovered and search-index status. Call this first.

tools.name: get_page_info
tools.description: Metadata for one page on https://sitemcp.dev/ without its full text: title, description, headings, canonical URL, published and modified dates, content type, language and word count. Use it to decide whether a page is worth reading.

tools.name: list_links
tools.description: Every link on one page of https://sitemcp.dev/, with its text and whether it stays on the site. Use it to navigate the site instead of guessing URLs.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "read_page" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Fetch a page from https://sitemcp.dev/ and return its main content as Markdown. Long pages are paginated with offset." → after: "Fetch a page from https://sitemcp.dev/ live and return its main content as Markdown, with when it was read and when the page says it last changed. Long pages are paginated with offset."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_site" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Search https://sitemcp.dev/ for pages relevant to a query. Returns matching pages with snippets." → after: "Search https://sitemcp.dev/ for pages relevant to a query. Returns matching pages with snippets, each with when it was read and when the page says it last changed."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
